# sca install

[← Command reference](../commands.md)

`<sca_options>` are the [global options](../commands.md#global-options).

```text
The sca install command help

The install command is used for installation of sca prerequisites.
There are two installation modes - offline and online.
When in online mode - while connected to internet, the installation are
performed against internet latest versions.
When in offline mode - while working in secure air-gap scenario the
installations are done against the locally present package downloads
available on sca USB stick.

Also, note that prerequisites related to sca USB stick iso creation are only
installed when in online mode as sca USB stick iso needs to download images and
packages over internet. Therefore they are not installed when installing 
offline.
```

**Syntax**

```text
sca [<sca_options>] install [<install_options>]

install_options:

  -h, --help                    - display install command help and exit
  -a, --air-gapped              - perform installations in offline mode
  -f, --force                   - overwrite any existing installations of sca
  -y, --yubikey-support         - includes apt-mirror of the yubikey tools in
                                  the image and installs the tools along with
                                  sca installation.
  -x, --exclude-pkcs11-support  - if specified excludes bundling of pkcs11
                                  support in the generated sca usb image
```

Automatic installs support apt-based systems (Ubuntu, Debian) only. Without
`apt-get` and `dpkg-query`, `sca install` stops before changing anything and
lists the packages the selected options need, so you can install them with your
own package manager (see the platform tables in
[SSH with a YubiKey](../ssh-yubikey-options.md#packages) and
[YubiKey Setup](../yubikey.md#prerequisites)).

Every package is attempted. If any fails to install (or, with `-a`, its `.deb`
is missing from the USB stick), `sca install` lists each failed package with the
command to retry and exits non-zero.

**Examples:**

```bash
# Online installation with YubiKey support
sca install --yubikey-support

# Offline installation (from SCA USB stick)
sca install --air-gapped

# Force reinstall
sca install --force
```

**Installed packages (online mode):**
- `openssl`, `openssh-client` - Core crypto tools
- `datefudge` - For backdating CA certificates
- `opensc`, `pcscd`, `libccid` - Smart card support
- `libengine-pkcs11-openssl` - PKCS#11 OpenSSL engine
- `yubico-piv-tool` - YubiKey management (with `-y`)
- `squashfs-tools`, `genisoimage`, `qemu-kvm` - USB image creation
